description: Translate the Sky Fortress travel preparation and Pukumon confrontation.

english:
ROG might be
there, so we'd
better get
ready.
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
You may have
noticed, but
Penmon in the
Central Room
seems to sell
healing and
equipment
items! We'll
keep helping
Patamon here!
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
Be careful,
Taiki. Don't
push yourself
too hard! If
your HP or MP
gets low
outside, look
for a Tent
Point and rest
in the healing
bed inside.
You'll feel
better!
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
To travel, go
to the Skyport
at the back of
the Commander
Room and ride
with the
Digimon Flight
Team.
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
All right,
Taiki! Let's
go! We'll ride
with the
Digimon Flight
Team and fly,
fly, fly!
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
I didn't know
you liked
flying so much,
brother...
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
I do not like
it...
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
But this is
kind of
exciting! All
right, let's
go!
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
You're not from
the Elestou
Zone...! You
must be with
ROG! Were you
waiting for
us...?
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
Oh, Spadamon,
keeper of the
Elestou Zone's
secrets. You
should have
stayed hidden.
Coming here to
be captured is
so pitifully
comical... How
foolish!
Pukuku!
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
That's exactly
what Lord
Pukumon says!
There's no way
this fool knows
the secret of
the Legendary
Ancient
Weapons... He
doesn't look
like he knows a
thing!
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
But if this
weak little
Spadamon really
does know the
secret, we'll
just grab him
right away!
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
...These fish
are flapping
their mouths
like they own
the place.
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
Grr... Those
guys make me so
mad! I'm not
weak anymore!
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
Pukumon! What
is ROG after?
Why are you
trying to
capture
Spadamon?
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
ROG's goal?
Pukuku! Isn't
it obvious?
World
domination!
Once we find
the Legendary
Ancient
Weapons, ROG
will rule the
world as we
please!
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
Magnificent!
What a rousing
speech! Just as
expected of our
Lord Pukumon!
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
ROG's Splash
Leader, Lord
Pukumon the
Prickle!
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english: Pukuku!
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
World
domination...?
You torment the
Digimon of this
Zone for that?
I won't let you
get away with
it!
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
I'll soon shut
that insolent
mouth of yours!
Pukuku!
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
How could I,
Lord Pukumon,
lose to a bunch
like you...?
This is
hilarious!
Pukuku!
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
What's so
funny?!
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
...Spadamon
will never give
up! Everything
is for our ROG
leader, Lord ZD
Millenniummon!
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
...I remember!
The Legendary
Ancient Weapons
are said to
have terrifying
power: in an
angel's hands,
they save the
world; in a
demon's, they
destroy it... I
thought that
was just an old
Elestou Zone
legend, but ROG
came here to
find those
weapons!
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
Destroy the
world...? No...
That can't
be... But why
would Spadamon
know such an
important
secret?
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
Maybe there's
been some
mistake. A huge
secret like
that wouldn't
be known by a
weak-looking
guy like
Spadamon...
It'd be someone
kingly, like
me!
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
...Huh? Did I
say something
weird?
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.

english:
Ha ha ha... He
doesn't mean
any harm...
blocks.review_note: Story, item-shop, and travel dialogue translated directly from Japanese; named features follow the project glossary.
